text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... Time really flies, huh, 
Trainer? It's already the new year... the 
Senior year, huh.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Still, this year I wanna make it 
undeniably my year, you know?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'd love to do that!
Yeah, I'd love to do that!

text_block_list.text:
Having pushed through last year's fierce 
battles, Jungle Pocket's eyes were shining 
bright.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Opera's not here. Neither is Doto. No 
Tachyon, no Dantsu. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
There's no one left to stand in our way. 
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
This is a desolate wasteland. I'm the only 
one standing here now. Which means—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm already the strongest. A clear, easy 
victory. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Tch, kinda boring.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
There's no point in boasting a win in the 
Twinkle Series without my archrival. 
Besides...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
According to the story... a benefactor 
from Hokkaido had mentioned something 
rather intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Back when I was doing freestyle 
racing, he was the caretaker who looked 
after me and the team.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Unlike the owner over here, that person 
specializes in racing. In other words, 
"L/Roars" has two owners.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: According to that person...

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
It's true Pocket defeated T.M. Opera O. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
I'm not the strongest yet. I only 
'defeated the strongest.'

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If you beat the strongest, you become the 
strongest. That's what I thought, but it 
seems that person doesn't think so.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't really ring a bell to me, but what 
about you, partner? Do you get it?
choice_data_list: Hmm... well, just a feeling, I guess...

text_block_list.text:
"Though TM Opera O had been defeated, not 
everyone acknowledged them as the true 
post-Opera O successor."

The time to prove who's truly the 
strongest starts now. The two of us 
decided to go pay our New Year's respects.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Now then, that takes care of the shrine 
visit... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, look over there. That Umamusume 
praying is...

—Narita Top Road. Her hands are clasped 
together, praying with perfect posture.

I don't know what she's praying for, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
We're roommates, you see. I heard a bit 
about what she plans to do from now on, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like she's staying... In the 
Twinkle Series this year too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Since she was hidden in Opera's shadow, I 
still haven't figured out the full extent 
of her true strength, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Pokke-chan. Are you here for Hatsumode 
too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It's the new year. Let's both do our best.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

New Year's... That phrase felt like it 
carried a resonance far beyond just a new 
year beginning.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, what are you doing for New 
Year's? You're not gonna start training 
right off the bat, are ya?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're hanging out, let's do 
something together. Show me some groovy 
ways to have fun."

A New Year's game that Jungle Pocket might 
enjoy. What should we play?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A New Year's dance? Is that what I think 
it is? The kind where you dance along to 
that "pyoruru~" flute sound?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Just watching this makes me wanna fall 
asleep. However—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna sleep. Believe it or not, 
I'm pretty damn particular about dancing.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right? My mom runs a club and knows all 
about dancing. So I'm an expert too, 
y'know.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's see what you've got. Just how 
good are you really?
And so, the New Year dance began, but—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: *snore*... *hnnngh*...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Mnh-mnh... Guts... I told you to put some 
guts into it, damn it... *snoooore*...

Unable to resist the slow-rhythmed 
drowsiness, Jungle Pocket ended up fast 
asleep the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Beigoma tops, huh? Nice. Clashing 
head-to-head in a fierce battle ought to 
get the momentum going, too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time to go find a suitable 
opponent.

—In a corner of the park. Those engaging 
in a beigoma battle were—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Here I go! Pegasus Spike Shooter!
(CRASH, rumble rumble rumble...)

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Biko-chan, you're strong...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Heheh, how d'ya like that!

Biko Pegasus—an Umamusume who loved heroes 
and toys alike—went on a consecutive 
winning streak.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yo, Biko. Count me in too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Come take on my ultimate beyblade, "Jungle 
GT Lion Fang"!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOH, let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Deryaaah, blow 'em away!
(CRASH, rumble rumble rumble...)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yay! Justice always prevails!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, damn it...! Was my tuning too soft? 
One more time, Biko, one more time!

"The battle grew heated. As both sides 
finely tuned their beigoma tops, they 
fought tooth and nail."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I see, a pilgrimage to Tokyo, huh. True 
enough, shrines aren't the only holy 
grounds for me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Then let's go, Trainer. To that place 
where the gods of racing reside."
And the place we arrived at was—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse... Yeah, it's gotta be 
here. This is my holy ground.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, an empty track on New Year's Day 
has a vibe of its own...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hm, you're right. Those guys are...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Jungle Pocket...? Why are you here...?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be the same as us, perhaps? 
Coordinating one's mindset for the New 
Year."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwahhhhh! Totally, right!? Whenever you 
come to this course, you just get all 
fired up.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Visiting familiar places is an important 
part of self-producing, too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I see. So you guys came out to 
celebrate too.

Umamusume who had achieved particularly 
stellar records at Tokyo Racecourse had 
gathered together.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, works for me. Let's all run 
together then.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tell me. What are your individual 
techniques for running this course? Let's 
make today a showcase.

Each of the five Umamusume showed off 
their signature running style, learning 
from one another.
